title: F-16 training coalition for Ukrainian pilots is formed at the Vilnius summit
body:
The F-16 training coalition was formed on 11 July 2023 at the NATO summit in Vilnius, Lithuania, to train Ukrainian pilots, technicians and support staff on F-16 fighter aircraft and to provide the jets. Denmark and the Netherlands led it. The original members were Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Sweden and the United Kingdom, with Ukraine as a partner.

On 17 August 2023 the United States approved the transfer of F-16s from Denmark and the Netherlands to Ukraine. Greece announced it would join the training effort on 22 August, and the United States did so on 24 August. Denmark pledged 19 jets in August 2023. Eight Ukrainian pilots and 65 support personnel arrived at Skrydstrup Air Base in Denmark in late August for basic tactical and technical training. Norway pledged jets on 25 August, Belgium on 11 October, and Bulgaria signed a memorandum on 12 October.

United States training was planned at Morris Air National Guard Base in Arizona, and some pilots began with the 162nd Wing around 25 October 2023. In Romania, the European F-16 Training Centre at Fetesti opened on 13 November 2023, after the first aircraft arrived on 7 November. On 22 December 2023 the first batch of 18 Dutch F-16s was announced.
